name: soundcheck-monorepo
description: SoundCheck monorepo - delegates to backend for Railway deployment

scripts.check:backend: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm test --prefix backend
scripts.check:mobile: cd mobile && flutter pub run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs && flutter analyze && flutter test
scripts.check: npm run harness:check && npm run check:backend && npm run check:mobile
